notes.en: Use for Los Angeles restaurant, retail, and commercial opening signals. Summaries must link to the source and avoid copied article text.
notes.zh: 用於洛杉磯餐飲、零售與商業開店訊號。摘要必須附來源連結，不得複製原文。

notes.en: Use for Los Angeles dining, neighborhood restaurant, and food-business signals only as original summaries with source links.
notes.zh: 用於洛杉磯餐飲、街區餐廳與食品商業訊號；只能寫原創摘要並附來源連結。

notes.en: Use for Los Angeles housing, development, transit-oriented development, and neighborhood planning signals.
notes.zh: 用於洛杉磯住房、開發、公共交通導向開發與街區規劃訊號。

notes.en: Use for transportation, safety, transit, and street-policy signals affecting Los Angeles families and commuters.
notes.zh: 用於影響洛杉磯家庭與通勤者的交通、安全、公交與街道政策訊號。

notes.en: Use for public Los Angeles events and local activity roundups when they are useful to bilingual families and students.
notes.zh: 用於對雙語家庭與學生有用的洛杉磯公共活動與本地生活整理。

notes.en: Use for broad Southern California civic, housing, transportation, and public-life signals that directly affect Los Angeles readers.
notes.zh: 用於直接影響洛杉磯讀者的南加州民生、住房、交通與公共生活訊號。

notes.en: Use for World Journal Chinese-language Los Angeles and Southern California local coverage with source-linked summaries only.
notes.zh: 用於世界新聞網洛杉磯與南加州中文本地報導；僅做來源連結摘要。

notes.en: Use as a Los Angeles Chinese-language local news and community information discovery source, especially for San Gabriel Valley reader needs.
notes.zh: 作為洛杉磯中文本地新聞與社區資訊發現來源，特別關注聖蓋博谷讀者需求。

notes.en: Use for official City of Los Angeles announcements that affect city services, business owners, commuters, or neighborhoods.
notes.zh: 用於影響城市服務、商家、通勤者或街區的洛杉磯市長官方公告。

notes.en: Use for LAX route, terminal, construction, and traveler logistics updates relevant to Los Angeles-area families.
notes.zh: 用於與洛杉磯家庭相關的 LAX 航線、航站樓、施工與旅運資訊。

notes.en: Use for Los Angeles County hiring and workforce notices when they are relevant to bilingual job seekers or local families.
notes.zh: 用於與雙語求職者或在地家庭相關的洛杉磯縣招聘與勞動力公告。

notes.en: Use only for repeated public San Gabriel Valley food-trend signals. Do not reuse captions, quotes, embeds, or media.
notes.zh: 只用於聖蓋博谷公開餐飲趨勢的重複訊號；不得重用 caption、引文、嵌入或素材。
